lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete clusters of high-luminance pixels organized into approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with a primary concentration of 20-25 distinct blobs in the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement most prominent in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running longitudinally; the most prominent ridge exhibits a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity values on the superior edge and low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-contrast white rectangular tag is attached to the upper posterior margin of the first dorsal fin, with a thin, low-luminance linear filament trailing behind it.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast objects (commensal fish) localized around the pectoral and pelvic regions of the primary subject.
